original.statement: OperatorHub packages for cert-manager are no longer published; v1.16.5 is the last release available on OperatorHub, and v1.17.0+ cannot be installed via that distribution channel.

decision.reason: [ev-a89ac42d3167] says cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages and that v1.16.5 is the last release on OperatorHub, for both RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io. That means cert-manager's link to OperatorHub as another product has ended, so the subject product-relationship "operatorhub" with change type "removed" matches what the evidence says. The validators came back inconclusive, so they neither confirm nor refute this.
